body.summary: Added src/workflow/convert/stamps.ts (stampRule, applyStamps, anchorOf: epicCreatedAt from the Define, ISSUE or SPEC head, else the earliest record of a standalone design; no source is a problem, a stamp already there is kept) and amendments.ts (amendmentRule, applyAmendments, flatToHead: a flat AMD becomes a { meta, body, citations } head still carrying legacy stamps so the ordinary head migration gives it its lifecycle; pending becomes a draft, approvedBy and sideEffects are kept in the body; a record with no proposedAt, an unknown status, no amendment or no work-item head is a problem).
